name: C-type lectin like 1

function.text: CLECL1 is the approved symbol for C-type lectin like 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in signaling receptor activity; B cell adhesion; positive regulation of interleukin-4 production.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Hepatocellular carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

selection_reason: Added to ensure complete representation of genes in the three Cancer Hotspots original release workbooks.

editorial.author: Codex — LLM source-linked hotspot supplement
editorial.change_note: Initial Cancer Hotspots dictionary supplement. Pathologist review needed — LLM-generated summary/review.

function.text: CLECL1 encodes C-type lectin like 1. Its functions include signaling receptor activity and B cell adhesion.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CLECL1 have been reported in hepatocellular carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
